101251.title: Rear wheel core assembly
guidance: Inspect 1 EA HL Mountain Rim (Product Number RM-M823) and 1 EA completed HL Hub (Product Number HU-8998) for visible damage before assembly.
Arrange 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283) and 36 EA HL Nipple (Product Number NI-9522) between the hub and rim using an assumed compatible lacing pattern.

101252.title: Tire, tube, and reflector fitment
guidance: Fit 1 EA Mountain Tire Tube (Product Number TT-M928) inside 1 EA HL Mountain Tire (Product Number TI-M823) and mount them on the rim, taking care not to pinch the tube.
Fit 2 EA Reflector (Product Number RF-9198) at compatible attachment points, then check that they are secure and clear of adjacent components.
